description.value: Swiss Bakery is an artisan bread specialist established in 1993 in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, known for handmade loaves, 81-layer laminated croissants, soft German pretzels, cinnamon buns, and its signature frissants. The shop has been a neighbourhood institution for over 25 years, drawing a loyal cross-section of regulars from construction workers to families. Touring cyclists passing through East Vancouver will find freshly made grab-and-go sandwiches, soups, and coffee on offer.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (8 spaces) at 56m; rack at 57m; rack (4 spaces) at 83m; rack (3 spaces) at 84m; stands (6 spaces) at 100m. Total: 21 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content successfully loaded and confirms Swiss Bakery at 143 East 3rd Avenue, Vancouver, matching OSM address and phone (+1 604 736 8785). No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site. The website does confirm hot food via 'soups' listed among grab-and-go offerings, and a minor discrepancy exists: OSM lists Saturday hours (Mo-Sa) but the website explicitly states as of July 2022 the store is Mon-Fri only, Sat & Sun closed.
concerns: OSM opening_hours lists Mo-Sa but website explicitly states as of July 2022 store is open Mon-Fri only, Saturday and Sunday closed — OSM Saturday hours appear outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active artisan bakery with a long-standing presence in Mount Pleasant; a practical food and coffee stop for touring cyclists in East Vancouver.
